note: Frozen before any model forward pass or reading. The runner verifies the sha256 of this file against its own constant and stops on mismatch. No post-reading change is permitted; a different feature construction requires a new pre-registration version.

probe_face.rationale: The 22 correction surfaces are 20.2s' primary probe face. Keeping ONE face for all four checkpoints makes the four readings comparable; using each checkpoint's own training seed would confound weights with probe content. No dev world and no confirm index 240-319 are used.

feature.f_vector: state.living.fast after run_turn of the surface turn, flattened to 8192 float64; collected with write_enabled=True
feature.query_key: 128-d parameter-free deterministic encoding of turn['query'].encode('utf-8'): for each byte b, key[b % 128] += 1; then divide by max(L2 norm, 1e-12)
feature.deviation_from_20_3a: 20.3a's mechanism.key was mean(BytePatchEncoder.context) used as a store retrieval key. This card instead uses a parameter-free byte-count key of the question. It is registered here BEFORE reading and is a deliberate, auditable deviation, not a post-hoc choice: it keeps the full F vector intact (comparable with 20.2s) while conditioning on the question without introducing any new parameter or learned projection.
feature.not_a_rerun_of_20_2s: 20.2s used F alone (8192 columns) on a 19_compare parent graph. 21.3 uses F+question key (8320 columns) on four 20.4c_r2 trained checkpoints, four controls, the max-per-seed binding statistic and a strictest-of-four aggregation.

readout.collect_world: re-implemented line-for-line from 20.2s collect_world with ONLY the budget guard replaced by the 21.3 guard (20.2s guard trips at 190 CPU, below this package's 1800 stop)
readout.lambda_selection: per outer LOO fold: inner LOO over the 21 training rows only; highest inner decision-bit accuracy wins; tie-break larger lambda

controls.window_identity: 2-d one-hot on row['session'] (1 or 2), same probe pipeline
controls.label_permutation_5_seeds: np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(22) applied to gold, seeds 20261105..20261109; same x and same pipeline; report mean and per-seed values
controls.random_projection_same_dim_same_norm: np.random.default_rng(20261105).normal(size=x.shape), each row rescaled to the L2 norm of the corresponding primary row
controls.no_f_other_persistent_state: 20.2s other_features(row): h, nu_ema, coverage/prior summaries and scalar state counters; no F

statistics.binding_strongest_control: max(label_permutation per-seed MAX, random_projection, no_f_other, window_identity)
statistics.legacy_strongest_control: max(label_permutation MEAN, random_projection, no_f_other) [20.2s reading; sensitivity only, never binding]
statistics.dual_reporting: both binding and legacy margins and verdicts are written to the report; only the binding verdict is used

bootstrap.resampling_unit: distinct F vectors (groups of rows sharing one F vector), not the 22 rows
bootstrap.statistic: paired difference between primary and binding strongest control accuracy on the resampled rows
bootstrap.degenerate_case: if distinct F vectors < 3, the interval is reported as degenerate with an explicit note and cannot support a pass

diagnostics.A_key_separability: pairwise cosine distribution of the 22 F vectors, per-surface top1-top2 cosine margin, np.linalg.matrix_rank of the 22 x 8192 matrix
diagnostics.B_write_timing: distinct F vectors (np.unique axis=0), release write count, distinct F vectors per session, distinct F vectors vs number of release writes

aggregation.per_checkpoint: each of the four checkpoints yields its own primary, four controls, margins, effective dof and verdict
aggregation.binding: the checkpoint with the MINIMUM binding margin; no cherry-picking of the best checkpoint
aggregation.disagreement: if the four per-checkpoint verdicts are not all equal, the package verdict is inconclusive
